requirements.acceptance: Exact ECU/firmware and bus-layout identity, supported by this target vehicle passive recording and reviewed trace.
Determine angle/torque mode and actual feedback/sign/units without merging candidate families.
Demonstrate driver brake, accelerator, cancel and steering override identities, distinct from stock ACC braking.
Document safety-relevant addresses, buses, lengths, periods, checksum/counter/quality fields and loss semantics.
Review minimum TX surface and offline tests proving inactive/invalid commands cannot grant authority.
Establish harness buses, original ECU ownership and forwarding transitions; no unsupported takeover assumption.
Demonstrate lateral ownership can be separated from stock ACC and does not suppress its control stream.
Resolve AEB channel and priority from evidence, including unknowns; a deceleration heuristic is insufficient.
Offline boundary, timing, disengagement, malformed-frame, loss and recovery tests for this exact family.
Pinned upstream/fork integration review and reproducible release-path safety tests; existing model enum is insufficient.
Independent review of target-specific logic and evidence, not a vendor support statement.
Resolve acceleration/brake/neutral/enable/stop-resume protocol independently of lateral support.
Resolve driver overrides and cancellation for longitudinal control.
Offline longitudinal state and boundary tests, including AEB priority and malformed/late/replayed messages.

notes: No safety thresholds are introduced or modified by this evidence gate.
Evidence verification records provenance and inventory consistency; it does not certify decoded semantics or safe actuation.
Longitudinal offline development requires prior lateral and stock ACC/AEB isolation evidence; the validator never authorizes road operation.
